name: US jobless claims
summary: US initial jobless claims 203,000 in the week to 14 Nov; 4-week average 197,750, about 1% above its 52-week low
state: Initial US jobless claims were 203,000 in the week to 14 Nov, with the four-week average at 197,750, about 1.3% above its 52-week low of 195,250 and far below the 15% Watch line (FRED). No newer figure was out on 23 Nov; the next weekly release is due on 25 Nov.
for_you: New US unemployment claims remain low, a sign that layoffs are not rising.
why: Weekly claims are the earliest hard data on US layoffs; a sustained rise usually comes before the unemployment rate turns.
drivers: Layoffs, hiring freezes, federal job cuts, storms, strikes and seasonal quirks.

rubric.normal: The 4-week average of initial claims is less than 15% above its 52-week low.
